title: Toward Responsible ASR for African American English Speakers: A Scoping Review of Bias and Equity in Speech Technology

bias_targets.methodology: Synthesizing quantitative and qualitative literature that measures Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) performance disparities (e.g., Word Error Rate) and Natural Language Processing (NLP) evaluation metric differences against non-standard dialects, specifically African American English (AAE).
Reviewing studies that evaluate algorithmic harms, ASR misrecognition rates, and hate speech classification biases that disproportionately affect Black speakers.
